title: Lubricant R&D reference material dossier
description: Reference-material object (break-point B5). A reference set is the discrimination ruler for a grease campaign: a Known Good that must pass and a Known Bad that must fail. Each entry is a dossier - resolved or not - and every history_evidence item must bind the recorded failure to the mechanism it demonstrates, because an unbound bad sample proves nothing and cannot discriminate a candidate. tier states how the reference set was established (direct history, long run without event, unresolved) and downstream_flag states whether the discrimination evidence it supports is complete.

allOf.$comment: A reference set that owns at least one RESOLVED Known Bad carries the discrimination evidence and must say so; a reference set whose tier is UNRESOLVED cannot yet carry it. Both lists may be empty: an empty list is an open recording, not a violation.
An unresolved tier has no resolved reference set behind it, so the discrimination evidence stays incomplete.

reference_id.description: Optional identifier for the reference set as a whole; individual dossiers carry their own reference_id.

known_good.description: Known Good dossiers. May be empty while a reference set is still being assembled.

known_bad.description: Known Bad dossiers. May be empty while a reference set is still being assembled.

dossier.description: One reference material dossier: what the material is, which formula it represents, the history that establishes it, how it is stored, and its safety reference. history_evidence may be empty for an UNRESOLVED entry only.

history_evidence_item.description: One recorded history event. mechanism_reference is required on every item: a known bad is only usable as a reference when the recorded failure is bound to the mechanism it demonstrates.
